test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C, what is the value of A in terms of B and C?
solution:
**Given:**

tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C

**Formula Used:**

tan (A - B) = (tanA - tanB)/(1+ tanAtanB)

**Calculations:**

⇒ tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C

⇒ tan A - tan B = tan A tan B tan C + tan C

⇒ ​tan A - tan B = tan C(tan A tan B + 1)

⇒ tan C = (tanA-tanB)/(1+tanAtanB)

⇒ tanC = tan(A - B)

⇒ C = A - B

⇒ A = B + C

**⇒ Hence, The option 1 is correct**
